html:
Operated by Vietlook Travel, this full day Hue City Tour is specially designed for international travelers who wish to explore the cultural, historical, and spiritual highlights of Vietnam’s former imperial capital in just one day.

Travel comfortably from Da Nang to Hue through the scenic Hai Van Tunnel, visit iconic royal tombs, ancient pagodas, and the UNESCO-listed Imperial Citadel, while gaining deep insight into the Nguyen Dynasty and Hue’s rich heritage. With professional service, experienced English-speaking guides, and carefully selected attractions, Vietlook Travel ensures a memorable and authentic journey.

ITINERARY

07:30 – 08:30
Our driver and English-speaking tour guide will pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang. Depart for Hue City via Hai Van Tunnel – the longest and most modern road tunnel in Southeast Asia.

09:15 – 09:45
Stop at Lap An Lagoon:

  • Enjoy a coffee break

  • Take photos of the peaceful natural scenery

  • Visit one of the largest pearl farms in Vietnam

11:00
Arrive in Hue and visit Khai Dinh Tomb – the most impressive and artistic royal tomb of the Nguyen Dynasty, featuring a unique blend of Asian and European architecture.

11:45 – 12:00
Lunch at a local restaurant and short rest.

12:45 – 13:00
Continue visiting:

  • Thien Mu Pagoda – the oldest and most beautiful pagoda in Hue, regarded as the spiritual symbol of the city.

  • Hue Imperial Citadel – a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site (since 1993). Here, you will learn about the 13 Nguyen Dynasty emperors who ruled Vietnam for over 140 years. Despite historical changes, the Citadel still preserves its remarkable historical value.

15:15 – 15:30
From the Citadel parking area, stop at a rest point for a short break before returning to Da Nang (approximately 2-hour drive).

18:00 – 18:30
Drop-off at your hotel.
End of tour services. Thank you and see you again!

TOUR PRICE: USD 35 / person

INCLUSION

  • Air-conditioned tourist coach

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • Mineral water on the coach

  • All entrance fees as per itinerary

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

  • Children policy:

    • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (sharing lunch with parents)

    • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion lunch)

    • Above 9 years old: Full adult price
